name: Alexander and Bonin
notes:
CLOSED. Shuttered permanently effective 2026-12-31 [sic — closure reporting is dated Dec 2024 across ArtNews/Art-Insider; co-founder Ted Bonin died in 2024 and Carolyn Alexander retired the gallery after 28 years]. Last exhibition (Bryce/Dittborn/Macchi) closed June 2024. Site returned HTTP 403 on 2026-08-17 (may be decommissioned or blocking automated access) — some stale pages were reportedly still indexed as of April 2026 despite the closure. Address 47 Walker St sourced from Yelp, a secondary source — not independently confirmed from the gallery's own site since it is inaccessible. Retained for registry completeness per project policy; recommend excluding from active crawl cadence entirely (no adapter should poll this venue) and surfacing distinctly in the coverage/dark layer as 'closed' rather than 'dark-seasonal'. The Venue schema in SPEC.md §4/§8 has no explicit closed/defunct field — recommend the pipeline team add one rather than overloading `notes` for this signal long-term.
